raw_text: THREAD: We've identified a coordinated campaign by Spamouflage-linked accounts pushing the 'COVID originated in India' narrative across Twitter, Facebook, and YouTube. The campaign uses at least 340 accounts posting in English, Hindi, and Chinese. The cited preprint has methodological flaws and was rejected by Nature Reviews. This is classic CCP information warfare targeting South Asian audiences.
